    Get OpenAlex matching parameters information

    oa_matching_info.Rd

    Returns a structured summary of the current OpenAlex matching configuration stored in the internal package environment. Parameters are grouped into logical categories for readability and ease of inspection.

    Usage

    oa_matching_info()

    Value

    A named list with five sublists grouping the OpenAlex parameters by functional category:

    thresholds

    Numeric score thresholds used for article matching: oa_probable_threshold, oa_min_threshold, oa_doi_threshold.

    weights

    Numeric weights applied to each component of the global matching score: oa_w_title, oa_w_authors, oa_w_year.

    query_controls

    Integer and logical parameters controlling query behaviour and candidate selection: oa_max_candidates, oa_api_key.

    author_window

    Parameters governing the sliding window strategy for author list analysis: oa_use_window, oa_window_size, oa_large_author_threshold.

    truncation

    Parameters controlling truncation penalty and symmetry tolerance in author matching: oa_min_coverage_ratio, oa_author_lambda, oa_sym_max_diff_abs, oa_sym_max_diff_prop.

    Details

    The function reads values directly from .checkrefr_env and displays them using cli formatting. It returns the full parameter list invisibly, allowing programmatic use without triggering side effects.

    See also

    grobid_server_info for the equivalent function reporting GROBID server state.

    Examples

    # Display and capture current OpenAlex parameters
params <- oa_matching_info()
#> 
#> ── OpenAlex Matching Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 
#> ── Score Thresholds ──
#> 
#> Probable match (oa_probable_threshold): 0.85
#> Minimum inclusion (oa_min_threshold): 0.55
#> DOI acceptance (oa_doi_threshold): 0.9
#> 
#> ── Scoring Weights ──
#> 
#> Title weight (oa_w_title): 0.7
#> Authors weight (oa_w_authors): 0.2
#> Year weight (oa_w_year): 0.1
#> 
#> ── Query Controls ──
#> 
#> Max candidates (oa_max_candidates): 3
#> API key (oa_api_key): xxxXXxxyzZ
#> 
#> ── Author Window Strategy ──
#> 
#> Use sliding window (oa_use_window): FALSE
#> Window size (oa_window_size): 2
#> Large author list threshold (oa_large_author_threshold): 10
#> 
#> ── Truncation Penalty & Symmetry ──
#> 
#> Min coverage ratio (oa_min_coverage_ratio): 0.65
#> Truncation lambda (oa_author_lambda): 0.4
#> Sym. abs. tolerance (oa_sym_max_diff_abs): 2
#> Sym. prop. tolerance (oa_sym_max_diff_prop): 0.1

# Access a specific subgroup programmatically
params$thresholds$oa_probable_threshold
#> [1] 0.85
params$weights
#> $oa_w_title
#> [1] 0.7
#> 
#> $oa_w_authors
#> [1] 0.2
#> 
#> $oa_w_year
#> [1] 0.1
#>
